# Municipal Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2012

**Resolution No. 055 — A Resolution Endorsing the Municipal Ordinance that Provides for the Supplemental Guidelines for the Implementation of the PhilHealth Circular #19 Series of 2003 (TB-DOTS Program)**

## Summary

This ordinance provides supplemental guidelines for the implementation of [[PhilHealth]] Circular No. 19, Series of 2003, which establishes the TB-DOTS (Directly Observed Treatment Short-Course) Outpatient Benefit Package. Tuberculosis remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality in [[Pitogo]]. The [[Department of Health]] (DOH) through the [[Rural Health Unit]] (RHU) intends to implement a medical treatment scheme under the TB-DOTS program. The outpatient benefit package aims to provide incentives to health providers delivering TB treatment services.

## Key Provisions

1. **TB-DOTS Implementation**: Establishes supplemental guidelines for the local implementation of the PhilHealth TB-DOTS Outpatient Benefit Package in accordance with PhilHealth Circular No. 19, S-2003.

2. **Health Provider Incentives**: The TB-DOTS outpatient benefit package provides incentive payments to health providers who deliver directly observed treatment services to tuberculosis patients.

3. **DOH/RHU Coordination**: The [[Department of Health]] through the [[Rural Health Unit]] shall implement the medical treatment scheme for tuberculosis patients in the municipality.

4. **PhilHealth Coverage**: Enrolled PhilHealth members and their dependents may avail of the TB-DOTS outpatient benefit package for tuberculosis treatment.
